[[Warmaster Tydus]] offers you a generous care package to endure the world after the [[Searing]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
[[Reforged]] [[Reforged Mode|mode]] active

===Objectives===
* Speak with Warmaster Tydus to accept his aid.

===Reward===
* 1000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 4 [[Skill Point]]s
* [[Tydus's Tips (5th edition)]]
* [[Belt Pouch]]
* [[Bag]]
* [[Superior Identification Kit]]
* [[Superior Salvage Kit]]
* [[Key#Prophecies_keys|Ascalonian Key]]
* [[Key#Prophecies_keys|Ascalonian Key]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest is marked as completed upon accepting it. Speak to Warmaster Tydus again to accept the rewards.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"In the wake of the Searing, we have to rely on each other to survive. I've got some items and tips to help you get started. Here, take this guide I've written as well. If you hope to grow stronger, you'll do well to reference it along your journey."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I love tips and won't say no to free stuff.
| decline = I already know how to play Guild Wars and I don't want your charity.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"Your adventure is just beginning. Continue tackling missions to grow stronger and move the story forward. We need you at your best if we're going to stand a chance against the Charr.''

:''"If you ever get stuck, open your inventory and check out my guide, Tydus's Tips. I worked hard on it, you know."''

==Notes==
* The [[Superior Identification Kit]] and [[Superior Salvage Kit]] are usually not available this early in Prophecies, being only offered by [[merchant]]s from the [[Crystal Desert]] or later [[region]]s.
